description: Agent task planner — Break a goal into verifiable steps for an AI agent: dependencies, tool per step, effort minutes and a done-when check. Offline post-processing removes bad dependencies, detects cycles, computes parallel waves, critical path and elapsed time, and flags tools outside your tools= list. Optional: context=, tools= (comma list), max= (3-15 steps). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

goal.description: e.g. Launch an email newsletter for a small bakery

name: ai_plan_steps
